purpose: Teach: アポロ/ライナー/ゼット/ナカ/シマ/鞭/ハンドブック/さらし

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、アポロ、絶対、月面着陸の本、絶対、読んだわよ
lines.en: Sho, I'm telling you — I actually read that Apollo moon-landing book, for real.
lines.style: Warm, conspiratorial lean-in. Speaking to a beloved younger child with genuine excitement about sharing knowledge. Slight emphasis on the facts themselves, not performing for him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、野球で、絶対、ライナー、絶対、打った人、絶対、テレビで、絶対、見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm serious — I saw someone hit a liner in baseball on TV, I really did.
lines.style: Bright, earnest rush of words. A six-year-old defending his own truth with the intensity of someone who needs her to believe him. Eyes wide, slight bounce in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの自転車、本気で、絶対、ゼット、絶対、マークの、絶対、ハンドル、絶対、お洒落でしょ?翔くん
lines.en: Sho, you have to see my bike — the Z-mark on the handlebars is really cool, right?
lines.style: Genuinely proud but not showy. Inviting him to share in something she likes, not needing validation but wanting his perspective. Warm, open tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼくのクラスの、絶対、ナカイ、絶対、君、絶対、面白い人だよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, there's this kid Nakai in my class — he's actually really funny.
lines.style: Small, genuine laugh underneath. Thoughtful pause before 'funny' — he's noticed something real about another kid and trusts her enough to mention it. Quiet observer sharing a discovery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くんと、本気で、絶対、動物園で、絶対、シマウマ、絶対、見たいわね、メイ姉さん
lines.en: I'd love to go to the zoo with you sometime, Sho — see the zebras together.
lines.style: Soft, tender invitation. Not commanding or overly enthusiastic, just genuine affection wrapped in a simple wish. Slow, unhurried pace. Like she's thinking out loud about something she wants.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、博物館で、絶対、鞭、絶対、ぼく、絶対、見たことあるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I actually saw a whip at the museum once — I've seen one before.
lines.style: Small, proud admission. A six-year-old claiming a memory he's not quite sure about but wants to defend. Slight hesitation, then gentle certainty. Seeking her acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お店の、絶対、ハンドブック、絶対、翔くんに、絶対、見せてあげるね
lines.en: I want to show you the store handbook sometime, Sho — there's stuff you'd like in it.
lines.style: Gentle, forward-thinking warmth. Planning a small future moment together. Unhurried tempo. Voice carries the quiet satisfaction of having something to give him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お祖母ちゃんち、絶対、暖簾の、絶対、さらし布、絶対、白くて、絶対、綺麗だよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Grandma's noren — that bleached cloth she hangs — it's so white and pretty.
lines.style: Soft, observant wonder. A young child noticing beauty in something ordinary and sharing it like a small gift. Tender, genuine appreciation in his voice. Slight trailing-off as he sits with the image.
